t: Three free digital art lessons that use Krita and explore art careers.
steps: Find the K20 Center Digital Arts Activities collection and read the three lesson titles.
Ask IT to install Krita on a test Windows or Mac computer.
Open Krita and try a few brushes.
Start with the shorter lesson, Image Mash-up.
Gather Wacom tablets for Clearly, This Is Art.
Plan for screen printing supplies before the lesson.
Save student files in a school folder.
